note: MCM 2016 D, Team 49436, "Who Moved My Opinion?", 22 A4 sheets of 595x842 with the running header "Team # 49436 Page N of 22" on every page, so printed page = PDF page, page 1 being the official summary sheet and page 22 the reference list. 26 measured regions on 12 pages and every one an exhibit, no exclusions, so 22 figure rows and 4 table rows account for all of them. The 22 rows cover 16 printed figure numbers because five of them are multi-panel and those five account for eleven rows: Figure 8 is three separately measured frames printed in one row, and Figures 13, 14, 15 and 16 are two panels each, so six of these rows carry no caption of their own. Figures 1 to 3 are one node-and-edge artwork in three arrangements - Figure 3 literally recombines the first two - and Figures 10 and 11 are unscaled hand-set sketches masquerading as plots, while Figure 5 is a MATLAB surface with three leftover data-tip callouts printed inside the art. The prose almost never cites by number: every "Figure N" and "Table N" in the text layer is a caption opening, the body points at exhibits with "as follow:" and "the figure below" instead, and the only numbered references are two page-20 sentences that say "figure 9" while describing Figure 15 - recorded against Figure 9, which is where the printed number points.
rules: 图注统一为 "Figure N." 与 "Table N."（数字后带句点），因此十六张图记 [caption.numbering]="Figure N."，四张表记 "Table N."；Figure 5 的题注末尾漏句点、Figure 8 的题注干脆没有句点，都照原样引 [caption.verbatim]。
题注位置：所有图形题注在图下方（含四组并排面板共用的题注），所有表格题注在表格上方，[caption.position] 逐条记录。

多面板行按"分别测量、共用一条题注"处理（[caption.verbatim]、[mention.first_page]）：Fig 8 是三个实测区（p13 左中右），Fig 13/14/15/16 各是两个实测区，每一区单独成行；题注只引在位置最左的那一行，其余各行 [caption_source]=none。区域序号与阅读顺序无关（p13 左框是 r3、p20 左框是 r1/r4），一律按 bbox 的 x 判断左右。

正文几乎不做带编号的引用：全文出现的 "Figure N"/"Table N" 都是题注开头，正文一律用 "as follow:"、"the figure below"、"the table below" 之类的指代，故这些行记 [mention.style]=[]、[mention.count]=0；唯一带编号的正文引用是 p20 两处 "figure 9"，而它们描述的其实是 Figure 15，按"引用记在被点名的编号所在行"的惯例记到 Figure 9 上（lead_pages=-7），并在 Figure 15 的笔记里写明这处错号。
四张表都是"无外框 + 一条整列竖线"的骨架，Table 1/2 另有顶线、表头下线和底线，Table 3 只有上下两条横线，Table 4 每行后都有横线；故 [table.rule_style] 一律记 vertical-rules，横线的具体分布写进各自笔记，避免与 booktabs 混淆。
Table 3 与 Table 4 没有独立表头行：列名与行首标签印在同一行，因此按"表头 1 行 + 数据行"如实记录（Table 3 只有一行数据，Table 4 两行数据、stub 标签重复两次而不是合并单元格），见 [table.header_rows]。

图形复用（[caption.verbatim] 与 [place.section_path] 可对照）：Figure 3 是把 Figure 1 与 Figure 2 两幅图拼在一处的"单层网络"，Figure 7 是 Figure 6 去掉一个判断框的缩版，Figure 8 的三帧是同一张网络图的三个时刻；数据图形（Fig 13-16）左右两栏的纵轴量纲不同却共用一条题注，Figure 15 左栏纵轴印的是接收信息节点比例而不是题注说的最终舆论。
